name: The Fridge
description: A see-through panel that gates the boxes underneath it until you fill enough sort columns. Resizable to 2x2, 2x3, 3x2 or 3x3.
howToPlay: Fill 5 sort columns to open the fridge in the top-left. You can see the boxes waiting behind the glass the whole time, so plan which colours you'll grab the moment it opens. The '?' box stays hidden through the glass — the fridge shows you it's there, not what colour it is. Tapping a box under the glass just shakes it until the counter hits 0.
author: Claude
